archetype: Modern SaaS Dashboard with Vibrant Accents (Archetype 3 & 4 Hybrid)

global_rules.emotion: Professional, efficient, yet vibrant and modern.
global_rules.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 for main layout containers, but tight gap-4 for Control Room Grids.
global_rules.typography: Use font-manrope for all headings and body. Headings must use tracking-tight to look premium.
global_rules.borders_and_shadows: Mix soft shadows (shadow-sm) with sharp 1px borders (border-slate-200) to ensure crispness (Neumorphism 'Clay & Crisp' variant). Avoid muddy shadows.
global_rules.testing: CRITICAL: MUST retain all existing data-testid attributes exactly as they are.

page_accent.description: To create visual continuity with the Message Center gradient, add a 4px tall decorative block at the very top edge of the page container using the accent.gradient.

header_section.layout: Flex container, justify-between, items-start. Margin-bottom: mb-8.
header_section.typography: Title: text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900. Subtitle: text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1.
header_section.bd_migration_button: Use outline variant, subtle text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100.

kpi_cards.description: Pain point fix: Add 4 KPI summary cards above the filters. Compute these dynamically from the existing table data array so no new endpoints are needed.
kpi_cards.layout: Control Room Grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6
kpi_cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
kpi_cards.icon_style: w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center mb-3

action_buttons.description: Pain point fix: Unify the 3 primary action buttons under a cohesive design system rather than arbitrary solid blocks.
action_buttons.style: Use soft backgrounds with brand-tinted text/icons and border. Implementaciones: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 hover:bg-emerald-100. Equipos: bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-100. Reparaciones: bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200 hover:bg-orange-100.
action_buttons.icons: Use Lucide-react icons for each button (e.g., CheckCircle, Package, Wrench).

filters_section.description: Pain point fix: Redesign generic filters into a structured Control Room panel.
filters_section.layout: Grid layout for the 6 fields: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 items-end.
filters_section.style: Container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm mb-6.
filters_section.typography: Labels should be text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 block.

warning_banner.description: Pain point fix: Transform flat yellow banner into a modern Glassmorphic Alert.
warning_banner.style: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between mb-6 shadow-sm
warning_banner.typography: text-sm font-semibold text-amber-800 flex items-center gap-3
warning_banner.animations: Add a small pulsing dot (w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse) next to the warning icon.
warning_banner.action_button: bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 text-amber-800 text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-amber-300

data_table.description: Pain point fix: Elevate table rows with hierarchy and hover states.
data_table.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden
data_table.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200. Text: text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-4 px-4
data_table.usd_column: Highlight the 'TOTAL USD' column. Font: font-bold text-slate-900. Add the 'Inversión Inicial' label underneath in text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider.

badges.style: rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wide border

avatars.style: w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-sm ring-2 ring-white
avatars.colors: Map based on segment (e.g., PYME -> bg-indigo-500, MG -> bg-fuchsia-500, etc.)

stepper.description: Pain point fix: Redesign the ESTADO column to be a highly legible, connected step indicator.
stepper.step_done: w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center border border-indigo-200
stepper.step_pending: w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-200 text-[10px] font-bold
stepper.connector: w-3 h-[2px] bg-slate-200. If previous step is done, connector can be bg-indigo-200.
stepper.icons: Use tiny Lucide icons inside the 'done' steps (e.g., Check w-3 h-3).

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT modify backend logic, API calls, or the data structure. Work strictly on the UI presentation in /app/frontend/src/pages/Quotes.jsx (or equivalent component).
Compute the new KPI cards purely from the client-side quotes array.
MUST retain all 'data-testid' attributes exactly. Ensure they are attached to the interactive elements (buttons, inputs) in your new design.
Use standard Shadcn UI primitives for Select, Input, Badge, Card, etc., but customize their Tailwind classes to match these guidelines.
